name: Volskaya Foundry

mechanic.title: Control Points & Triglav Protector
mechanic.description: One of three Control Points (Top, Mid, or Bot) activates periodically (first warning at 2:00, spawns at 2:30; 2:00 cooldown after a Protector is destroyed or expires). Teams capture the point by standing inside without enemies present until progress reaches 100%, triggering Overtime if contested at 99%. Winning spawns a two-player Triglav Protector mech—piloted by a Driver (melee/charge/shields) and a Gunner (long-range lasers/gatling/mortars)—that scales in power over the match.

camps.name: Support Camp / Biotic Emitter (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near top-left and bottom-right. Drops a deployable Biotic Emitter item that creates a large AoE healing zone for allied heroes—invaluable during prolonged Control Point fights.

camps.name: Fortification Camp / Turret (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the top-mid and bottom-mid alcoves. Drops a deployable Turret item that fires automatically at nearby enemies and structures.

camps.name: Siege / Rocket Troopers (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the upper and lower side paths. Fires long-range rockets down lanes; easy to clear right before Control Points activate.

camps.name: Bruisers / Goliaths (1 Central Camp)
camps.notes: Located in the dead center below the Mid point. Heavy melee/ranged mercenaries that push mid lane aggressively.

strategy: Volskaya Foundry has no Boss camp and revolves around sustained teamfights over conveyor-belt Control Points that frequently stretch into lengthy Overtimes. Heroes with strong zone control, poke, and sustain (such as Junkrat, Chromie, Blaze, and Lucio) excel here. Always grab the Support (Healing Pulse) and Turret camps right before an objective spawns so you can drop them directly onto the point during a contest, and put your tank or melee bruiser in the Triglav Driver seat while a ranged assassin or support mans the Gunner turret.
